title: Turnover data
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Turnover data Nov 15, 1995| Circulars NO. SMD/AA/4081/95 15th November, 1995 To, The Executive Director Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Turnover data Please send us the monthly gross turnover data (single side) for the months of April, 1995 till date. Gross turnover (net of jobbing) on single side basis may also please be indicated. This is urgent please. Yours faithfully, sd/- (AFTAB ALAM) DIVISION CHIEF - SMD
